title: Towards a faithful stochastic model for brain digital twins
abstract: arXiv:2609.13973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Twinning the brain means reproducing its electrical activity with fidelity. This activity arises from many neuronal mechanisms across several scales, from a single neuron to whole brain regions. Current large initiatives rely on models that each capture only a few of these mechanisms. Some act at the scale of a single neuron, others at the scale of neuronal populations. No single model captures both scales with fidelity. We propose a new stochastic model, based on a combination of Random Neural Networks and Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes, that would improve the fidelity of a brain digital twin. We map the model to the Discrete Event System Specification. This yields an initial executable simulation model suitable for incorporation into a brain digital twin.

translated_title: 迈向忠实的大脑数字孪生随机模型
translated_abstract: 对大脑进行数字孪生意味着忠实地再现其电活动。这种电活动源于多个尺度上的多种神经元机制，从单个神经元到整个脑区。目前的大型研究计划所依赖的模型各自仅能捕捉其中少数几种机制：有些作用于单个神经元的尺度，另一些则作用于神经元群体的尺度，没有任何单一模型能够忠实地同时捕捉这两个尺度。我们提出了一种新的随机模型，该模型基于随机神经网络与马尔可夫调制泊松过程的结合，可以提升大脑数字孪生的保真度。我们将该模型映射到离散事件系统规范（DEVS），从而得到一个初始的可执行仿真模型，适合纳入大脑数字孪生之中。
tldr: 提出了一种将随机神经网络与马尔可夫调制泊松过程相结合的新型随机模型，并映射到离散事件系统规范以生成可执行的仿真模型，从而提升大脑数字孪生在单神经元和神经元群体两个尺度上的保真度。
en_tdlr: A new stochastic model combining Random Neural Networks and Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes, mapped to the Discrete Event System Specification, is proposed to improve the fidelity of brain digital twins across both single-neuron and neuronal population scales.
